about.text1: Oniwadi, olùfọkànsí, ati itara lati kọ ẹkọ... :)
about.text2: Agbara mi: idasi si awọn iṣẹ akanṣe ti o ni ipa nibiti imọ-ẹrọ le mu awọn nkan dara si nitootọ... ati yago fun ṣiṣẹda kokoro miiran
about.text3: Ibi-afẹde mi: dagbasoke bi olùgbéejáde ti o wapọ, nigbagbogbo ni ilọsiwaju, nigbagbogbo n wa awọn solusan ti o munadoko ati iwulo... pẹlu kafiini kekere ati igbadun pupọ

details.lang_desc:
• C / C++
  • Python – Backend, AI, Iwe afọwọkọ, Adaṣiṣẹ
  • Django + Django REST Framework
  • JavaScript / Node.js
  • ReactJs
  • SQL & DAX (Power BI)
  • HTML / CSS

details.db_desc:
• MongoDB (NoSQL)
  • MySQL / PostgreSQL
  • Awọn ibi ipamọ data ibatan nipasẹ Django
  • Apẹrẹ Schema & Iṣilọ
details.data_desc:
• NumPy • pandas • scikit-learn
  • NLP (Ṣiṣẹda Ede Adayeba)
  • Pipeline pipe: Scraping → Cleaning → Analysis → Prediction
  • Whisper + FFMPEG (Gbigbasilẹ Ohun/Fidio)
details.web_desc:
• Scraping to ti ni ilọsiwaju (Selenium, requests)
  • Adaṣiṣẹ ti awọn iṣẹ ṣiṣe atunwi
  • REST APIs • Webhooks • Isopọmọ ẹni-kẹta
  • OAuth2 (Youtube, Google, Linkedin…)
  • Celery + Redis (Awọn iṣẹ ṣiṣe Asynchronous)
details.tools_desc:
• Power BI
  • Azure (Awọn ipilẹ: VMs, Blob, Functions)
  • Git & GitHub Actions (CI/CD)
  • Docker • Docker Compose
  • Postman • Swagger
details.tests_desc:
• Awọn Idanwo Unit: Ibora ti awọn iṣẹ pataki, ọgbọn iṣowo, awọn iṣẹ, awọn ohun elo.
  • Awọn Idanwo Iṣẹ: Ijerisi pipe ti awọn ṣiṣan iṣẹ olumulo ati awọn aaye ipari API.
  • Awọn Idanwo Isopọmọ: Awọn ibaraenisepo laarin awọn iṣẹ, awọn ibi ipamọ data, awọn API ita.
  • Mocking & fixtures: Iyasọtọ ti awọn igbẹkẹle, atunṣe awọn oju iṣẹlẹ.
  • CI/CD: Awọn idanwo adaṣe, linting ati imuṣiṣẹ (GitHub Actions / Docker).

results.title: Ilana Ti Ara Ẹni Rẹ

routines.oily: Ọṣẹ Ifọmọ (fun apẹẹrẹ, CeraVe Foaming, La Roche-Posay Effaclar, Bioderma Sebium) + Omi-ara (fun apẹẹrẹ, The Ordinary Niacinamide, Paula's Choice Pore, Inkey List Niacinamide) + Jeli (fun apẹẹrẹ, Neutrogena Hydro Boost, Clinique Dramatically Different Gel, Versed Dew Point)
routines.dry: Wara/Epo (fun apẹẹrẹ, La Roche-Posay Toleriane, DHC Oil, Aveeno Calm+Restore) + Omi-ara (fun apẹẹrẹ, Hyalu B5, Vichy Minéral 89, The Ordinary HA) + Ipara (fun apẹẹrẹ, CeraVe Cream, First Aid Beauty Ultra Repair, Vanicream)
routines.combo: Jeli Pẹlẹ (fun apẹẹrẹ, Bioderma Sensibio, Fresh Soy, Youth to the People) + Omi-ara (fun apẹẹrẹ, The Ordinary Buffet, Caudalie Vinoperfect, Estée Lauder ANR) + Omi (fun apẹẹrẹ, La Roche-Posay Effaclar Duo, Kiehl's Ultra Facial, Clinique Moisture Surge)
routines.sensitive: Omi Micellar/Wara (fun apẹẹrẹ, Bioderma Sensibio, Aveeno Calm, Cetaphil Gentle) + Omi-ara (fun apẹẹrẹ, La Roche-Posay Toleriane, Dr. Jart+ Cicapair, Aveeno Triple Oat) + Ipara Gbigbọn (fun apẹẹrẹ, Cicaplast B5, Avene Cicalfate, Uriage Bariéderm)
routines.default: Ọṣẹ Ifọmọ Pẹlẹ + Ipara Fẹlẹfẹlẹ + Aabobo Oorun

hands_feet.title: Itọju Ọwọ & Ẹsẹ
hands_feet.oily: Ọwọ: Ipara fẹlẹfẹlẹ (fun apẹẹrẹ, Neutrogena Hydro Boost, L'Occitane Verbena, Aesop Resurrection). Ẹsẹ: Scrub (fun apẹẹrẹ, The Body Shop Peppermint, Lush Pumice) + Gel (fun apẹẹrẹ, Scholl Fresh, L'Occitane Shea).
hands_feet.dry: Ọwọ: Ipara atunṣe (fun apẹẹrẹ, CeraVe Hand, O'Keeffe's Working Hands, Neutrogena Norwegian). Ẹsẹ: Urea (fun apẹẹrẹ, Eucerin 10% Urea, CeraVe SA Renewing, Gold Bond).
hands_feet.combo: Ọwọ: Moisturizing (fun apẹẹrẹ, Nivea Soft, Vaseline, Aveeno Daily). Ẹsẹ: Nourishing (fun apẹẹrẹ, Burt's Bees Coconut, Palmer's Cocoa Butter, Sol de Janeiro).
hands_feet.sensitive: Ọwọ: Laisi oorun (fun apẹẹrẹ, Aveeno Relief, Eucerin Advanced, CeraVe Therapeutic). Ẹsẹ: Apaisant (fun apẹẹrẹ, La Roche-Posay Lipikar, Aveeno CICA, Cetaphil).
hands_feet.default: Mu ọwọ rẹ mu omi lẹhin gbogbo fifọ. Tọju ẹsẹ rẹ ni alẹ.

acne.advice: Salicylic Acid (BHA) ni ọrẹ rẹ to dara julọ. Maṣe gbagbe lati tutu awọ rẹ; awọ ti o gbẹ nmu epo jade diẹ sii!
acne.products: Patch (e.g., COSRX), Salicylic Acid (e.g., Paula's Choice 2% BHA), Niacinamide

aging.advice: Retinol jẹ boṣewa wura fun egboogi-ogbo. Bẹrẹ laiyara (1-2 igba ni ọsẹ kan) ni alẹ. SPF jẹ dandan ni owurọ!
aging.products: Retinol (e.g., CeraVe Resurfacing, The Ordinary 0.2%), Vitamin C (e.g., La Roche-Posay), SPF 50+

dullness.advice: Yiyọ awọ ti kemikali (AHA bi Glycolic Acid) ati Vitamin C yoo ji imọlẹ rẹ.
dullness.products: Vitamin C (e.g., Garnier, Vichy), Glycolic Acid Toner (e.g., The Ordinary 7%), Radiance Mask

dry.advice: 'Slugging' (fifi Layer tinrin ti Vaseline ni alẹ) le gba idena awọ ara rẹ là.

sensitive.advice: Ṣe ilana rẹ rọrun. Yago fun awọn turari, ọti, ati awọn scrub ti ara.
sensitive.products: Centella Asiatica (e.g., Dr. Jart+), Panthenol (B5), Colloidal Oatmeal

pigmentation.advice: Inhibiting tyrosinase jẹ bọtini. Darapọ exfoliation pẹlẹ pẹlu aabo oorun ti o muna lati yago fun awọn aaye lati ṣokunkun.
pigmentation.products: Thiamidol (e.g., Eucerin Anti-Pigment), Tranexamic Acid (e.g., Paula's Choice, The Inkey List), Azelaic Acid (e.g., The Ordinary 10%), Vitamin C (e.g., La Roche-Posay Pure Vitamin C10), SPF 50+ (Mandatory!)

advice.oily: Lo salicylic acid lẹmeji ni ọsẹ kan.
advice.dry: Yago fun omi gbigbona ati awọn ọja ti o ni ọti.
advice.combo: Fi omi si ẹrẹkẹ rẹ daradara ki o tọju agbegbe T ni agbegbe.
advice.sensitive: Kere jẹ diẹ sii. Ṣe pataki awọn ọja ti ko ni oorun.

responses.forest: Mo jẹ ẹdọforo ti ilẹ, awọn gbongbo mi gba itan-akọọlẹ agbaye mọra. Tẹtisi kẹlẹkẹlẹ awọn ewe mi, o gbe ọgbọn ti awọn ọgọrun ọdun.
responses.ocean: Nla ati jinle, Mo ṣọ awọn aṣiri ti ọgbun naa. Oju mi n ṣe afihan ọrun, ṣugbọn ọkan mi n lu si ilu ti ṣiṣan ayeraye.
responses.sun: Mo jo lainidi lati fun ni iye. Imọlẹ mi n le awọn ojiji lọ, o si nmu gbogbo ọkan, gbogbo okuta, gbogbo ireti gbona.
responses.moon: Ayaba alẹ, Mo ṣọ awọn ala rẹ. Ninu ipalọlọ fadaka, Mo ṣe amọna aririn ajo ti o sọnu ati akewi ti o dawa.
responses.wind: Airin ati alagbara, Emi ni ẹmi iyipada. Lilu oju, yiyọ iyemeji, aririn ajo ti ko ni dè.
responses.mountain: Aini gbigbe ati igberaga, Mo kan awọn awọsanma. Oke mi jẹ ipenija, afonifoji mi jẹ ibi aabo. Emi ni sũru ti o yipada si okuta.
responses.flower: Ẹwa ti o pẹ, Mo ṣii pẹlu oore-ọfẹ si agbaye. Gbogbo petal jẹ ileri ti awọ, ẹrin si imọlẹ.
